      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/account/password", produces="application/problem+json", consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> changePassword(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid ChangePasswordRequest changePasswordRequest)
      POST /api/account/password : Changes the password of the authenticated account Requires a bearer token issued by this server.
      Parameters:
      changePasswordRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      Password changed (status code 204) or Wrong current password or rejected new password (status code 400) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401)

    • register

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/account/register", produces="application/problem+json", consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> register(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid RegisterRequest registerRequest)
      POST /api/account/register : Registers an account The answer is the same whether or not the e-mail address or the username is already taken. Rate limited per client address and per e-mail address.
      Parameters:
      registerRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      Registration accepted; an e-mail is sent (status code 202) or Invalid request or rejected password (status code 400) or Too many requests from this client or for this address (status code 429) or The e-mail could not be sent; nothing was registered (status code 503)

    • requestPasswordReset

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/account/password/reset-request", produces="application/problem+json", consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> requestPasswordReset(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid PasswordResetRequest passwordResetRequest)
      POST /api/account/password/reset-request : Requests a password reset link The answer is the same whether or not the e-mail address belongs to an account; only a registered address receives a message. Rate limited per client address and per e-mail address.
      Parameters:
      passwordResetRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      Request accepted; a registered address is sent a link (status code 202) or Invalid request (status code 400) or Too many requests from this client or for this address (status code 429)

    • resetPassword

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/account/password/reset", produces="application/problem+json", consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> resetPassword(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid ResetPasswordRequest resetPasswordRequest)
      POST /api/account/password/reset : Resets a forgotten password A rejected password does not use up the token. Rate limited per client address.
      Parameters:
      resetPasswordRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      Password reset (status code 204) or Invalid token or rejected password (status code 400) or Too many requests from this client or for this address (status code 429)

    • verify

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/api/account/verify", produces="application/problem+json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> verify(@NotNull @Valid @RequestParam(value="token",required=true) @NotNull @Valid String token)
      GET /api/account/verify : Verifies an e-mail address A verification link works once. Rate limited per client address.
      Parameters:
      token - Verification token received by e-mail. (required)
      Returns:
      E-mail address verified (status code 204) or The token is invalid, expired or already used (status code 400) or Too many requests from this client or for this address (status code 429)
